source._comment: WIRED 2026-10-15: the SoS daily 'Early and Absentee Voters' report, linked from sos.tn.gov/govotetn as <YYYYMMDD>Day<N>Turnout.xlsx (sheet EarlyAbsentee: County, Date, Day Total + a Statewide row). Totals include in-person early voters, absentee by-mail ballots returned and voters at licensed facilities (per the report's footnote) -- no method or party split. Fallback: the UF Election Lab's TN rows (same report). The page also links a '2026 vs. 2022 through N days' comparison PDF.
